english.note: Use this technical term for a system whose outcomes are highly sensitive to its starting conditions.

examples.english: This phenomenon is highly sensitive to its starting conditions, so it is a chaotic system.
examples.traditional: 呢種現象對初始條件極度敏感，屬於混沌系統。
